'''Scott Church''' (GEMP handle '''Categoryon''')<ref name="p1337740">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1337740#p1337740 Sign-up post by CategoryOneGames.com] (real name / forum name / GEMP screen name), in [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=77430&start=60 Sealed league signups (page 4)], forum.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013160112/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t77430-start60.html Internet Archive], [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021062432/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t77430.html Internet Archive]</ref> is a competitive Star Wars CCG player documented from Players Committee tournament sources.

On 1 June 2005 he announced that, alongside the Star Wars state championship in Utah, he would run the [[2005 Utah Young Jedi State Championship|Young Jedi state championship]] on 11 June 2005 at Dragon's Keep in Provo, starting at 1 PM with Young Jedi packs as prizes.<ref name="pcf-5734-80424" /> In August 2008, posting as CategoryOneGames.com, he wrote that [[Ryan Freeman]] had won the [[2007 Utah State Championship]].<ref name="pcf-21070-330667">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=330667#330667 Oregon States], Scott Church (CategoryOneGames.com), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (24 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080903083823/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=330749 Internet Archive]</ref> In 2008 he announced and organized the [[2008 Utah State Championship]] and the [[2008 Tatooine Regionals]] at Press Box Sports Cards in Sandy, Utah, on 20 and 21 June,<ref name="sf-19270-270348" /> finishing third at both,<ref name="sf-19270-308685" /><ref name="sf-19270-308762" /> and kept a "Road to Worlds" calendar of the 2008 events in the western United States.<ref name="sf-21008-303347">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=303347#p303347 Road to Worlds - Western US - All West States Events/Plans], CategoryOneGames.com (Scott Church), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (23 May 2008).</ref> [[Cedric Simon]] confirmed his Tatooine Regionals automatic bid for Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship]] in July 2008.<ref name="sf-19270-315735">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=315735#p315735 Utah States & Tatooine Regionals June 20 & 21st], simone89 (Cedric Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (16 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125175210/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19270-start160.html Internet Archive]</ref>
